nodes.label: D-001 Python 3.11+ setuptools package under backend
nodes.rationale: Setuptools is the most familiar build backend for students; one editable install gives import and command.

nodes.label: D-002 No runtime dependencies yet (argparse, dataclasses)
nodes.rationale: FastAPI/Pydantic/NetworkX not needed for file-level change extraction; added only when milestones need them.

nodes.label: D-003 Git CLI via subprocess, not PyDriller/GitPython
nodes.rationale: Git CLI already required, exact documented output formats, avoids extra dependency; safety via argument lists and --end-of-options.

nodes.label: D-004 Line-range convention
nodes.rationale: Keeps pure deletions visible and gives the method mapper both base and head sides.

nodes.label: D-005 Report all changed files, flag Java ones
nodes.rationale: Build/config changes such as pom.xml can affect tests.

nodes.label: D-006 Directories created on demand
nodes.rationale: Follows the brief: no empty placeholder packages.

nodes.label: D-007 Maven not required locally for Milestone 0
nodes.rationale: Maven not installed on bootstrap machine; CI builds sample project; required locally from Milestone 3.

nodes.label: D-008 Tree-sitter Java for syntax-level declaration extraction
nodes.rationale: Pure pip install, error-tolerant, exact positions, offline wheels; syntax-only so types recorded as written.

nodes.label: D-009 Declaration IDs and change attribution rules
nodes.rationale: Innermost-declaration attribution and head/base mapping make added/deleted/modified explicit; syntax errors go to unresolved rather than guessing.

nodes.label: D-010 Simplified Java name resolution with confidence labels
nodes.rationale: Subset of JLS scoping rules; ambiguous or uncertain matches labelled heuristic or unresolved, never guessed as confirmed.

nodes.label: D-011 Plain dictionaries, not NetworkX, for the graph
nodes.rationale: Graph only needs node/edge dicts and BFS readable by every team member; export to NetworkX later if metrics are needed.

nodes.label: D-012 Impact on union of BASE and HEAD graphs, confirmed-first
nodes.rationale: Union follows dependencies removed by the change, which is conservative for test selection; confirmed-first BFS gives confirmed explanation paths.

nodes.label: D-013 Java only (scope)
nodes.rationale: Parsing, resolution, test discovery and coverage are language-specific; other languages would multiply work.

nodes.label: D-014 Running builds is opt-in and isolated
nodes.rationale: Running tests executes project code and Maven plugins, which the brief forbids doing automatically; isolation from user files, not a sandbox.

nodes.label: D-015 Per-test coverage by one Maven run per test class
nodes.rationale: JaCoCo records one exec file per JVM; per-class runs are the simplest exact method.

nodes.label: D-016 Selection rules chosen for safety
nodes.rationale: Unknown is not safe: missing coverage selects tests, non-Java changes trigger retest-all.

nodes.label: D-017 Product direction: platform, own IDE, website (Java first)
nodes.rationale: Team decision; research milestones keep priority; wider scope needs supervisor approval.

nodes.label: D-018 Language-plugin interface
nodes.rationale: Keeps core language-neutral; shared graph schema keeps IDE, selection and ML language-neutral.

nodes.label: D-019 CodeDNA IDE built on Eclipse Theia, local API
nodes.rationale: Writing an editor from scratch is out of reach; Theia is built for custom IDE products and supports VS Code extensions.

nodes.label: D-020 Platform website and plugin distribution
nodes.rationale: Plugins are code running with user permissions, so install only from official catalogue, verify SHA-256, pin versions.

nodes.label: D-021 SQLite (standard library) for history and results
nodes.rationale: No server, works on every laptop, easy to copy alongside experiments.

nodes.label: D-022 scikit-learn for the first models
nodes.rationale: Covers logistic regression baseline and gradient boosting without XGBoost/LightGBM; optional extra.

nodes.label: D-023 Feature, leakage and evaluation protocol
nodes.rationale: History features use only earlier commits; chronological 60/20/20 split prevents leakage.

nodes.label: D-024 Plugin refactor, step 1
nodes.rationale: Avoid packaging work before the plugin catalogue (Milestone 7) is needed.

nodes.label: D-025 Calibration methods and where they are fitted
nodes.rationale: Calibrators fitted only on validation split so calibration never sees test data; Platt safer for small data.

nodes.label: D-026 Risk-aware selection and fallback rules
nodes.rationale: Skip risk assumes independent failures and is compared to observed miss rate; no guarantee claimed.

nodes.label: D-027 Experiment protocol for Milestone 5
nodes.rationale: Reproducibility: dataset SHA-256, seed, package versions recorded.

nodes.label: D-028 Local API: FastAPI on loopback with session token
nodes.rationale: Localhost server reachable by local processes and browser pages; token, Host check and no CORS defend against that.

nodes.label: D-029 IDE skeleton: Theia 1.76.0, Electron, backend proxy
nodes.rationale: Backend proxy keeps the token out of the renderer and avoids CORS.

nodes.label: D-030 Visual design: CodeDNA Dark + glass shell
nodes.rationale: Requested by team from reference shots of dark translucent UIs.

nodes.label: D-031 Newcomer-friendly wording and calmer look (revises D-030)
nodes.rationale: Beginners should be able to use CodeDNA; teal/indigo glow read as generic AI; analysis unchanged.

nodes.label: D-032 RTPTorrent as primary study dataset, imported without builds
nodes.rationale: Real CI outcomes at test-class level linked to commits with bare repos; no third-party code executed.

nodes.label: D-033 Pin tree-sitter below 0.26 (native crash)
nodes.rationale: tree-sitter 0.26.0 crashed with access violation on HikariConfig.java; 0.25.2 parsed full history.

nodes.label: D-034 Study protocol: six projects, five seeds, separated fallback triggers
nodes.rationale: B9 gain came mostly from non-Java retest-all rule; B9r/B9n isolate the triggers.

nodes.label: D-035 Cost-matched comparisons, bootstrap intervals, shared parse cache
nodes.rationale: Fallback policies won partly by running more tests; cost-matched B8 comparison answers RQ4; hierarchical bootstrap handles seed sensitivity.

nodes.label: D-036 Hybrid policy B10: rules order, calibrated stopping
nodes.rationale: Rules order tests better, calibrated model gives reliable risk estimates; B10 combines them.

nodes.label: D-037 Class-weight check as stricter RQ3 baseline
nodes.rationale: Balanced class weights inflate raw probabilities, so raw-vs-calibrated partly measures undoing that choice.

nodes.label: D-038 Reproducible figures from saved study reports
nodes.rationale: Figures exported from saved reports with SHA-256 manifest so they tie to a specific snapshot; no reruns.

nodes.label: D-039 Pre-specified project-disjoint transfer check
nodes.rationale: Owner requested testing cross-project model transfer; projects chosen before inspecting results.
